objective: Establish which allocation, representation, and agent conclusions survive clean temporal calibration, controlled response difficulty, strict article holdouts, and matched baselines.

analysis.uncertainty: 95% Student-t intervals across pools and paired policy differences. Sensitivity grids are reported in full. Follow-up choices are labeled exploratory.
analysis.evaluation_day_status: November 15 has been inspected in earlier work. This is a locked retrospective protocol, not an untouched confirmation set.
analysis.preservation: Original checkpoints and results remain separate from follow-up outputs. Report writing is deferred.

temporal_simulator.refit: November 9-13, after selecting an epoch for each family

q1_allocation.tuning: training-day pools only, expected total reward

diagnostics: chosen-arm agreement with each statistic on tool-call rounds

q4_llm_ablation.design: one-factor changes from the existing baseline, paired environments, 30 pools, 500 decisions

q2_robustness.strict_holdout: Evaluation article IDs absent from every earlier training candidate list and history. Exclude those IDs when fitting all reductions.
q2_robustness.normalization: All follow-up policy feature normalization fits earlier article rows only, including the scalar row-norm normalization.

controls: random thresholded features matched in activation frequency
q2_q3_controls.validation: Full UCB score interventions and deletion/retraining comparisons. Semantic matching with shuffled labels and held-out headlines. Automated checks are labeled automated, and human review is never fabricated.
q2_q3_controls.width_followup: Exploratory 16,384-candidate random dictionaries with source activation-frequency distribution and identical top128 training-variance selection, evaluated on the full dimension/coefficient grid.

synthetic.purpose: Validate probability, oracle, pairing, and policy behavior against known controlled responses.

completion_checks: All planned primary experiments finish successfully and have complete per-pool outputs.
Inputs, source hashes, seeds, account, scheduler job IDs, and runtime are recorded.
Probability bounds, zero-gap behavior, oracle definitions, and original-output preservation are checked.
No policy setting is selected from evaluation outcomes in a primary comparison.
Every proposed empirical claim is tied to a table and its paired uncertainty, including negative and inconclusive findings.
Results are audited for simulator dependence, representation confounds, and LLM contribution beyond the statistics tool.
Further experiments are chosen only to resolve an identified ambiguity and recorded as exploratory.

human_validation.claim_scope: External-label retrieval agreement and permutation controls, without human-annotation claims.
human_validation.same_captioner: All first32 coordinates across dense, SAE, small and wide random directions, small and wide thresholded random directions, and shuffled-noise controls. One blinded captioner; held-out category-matched retrieval; no human annotation claims.
